claims.summary: Over F2, coordinate interpolation defects D_j=I-L_j act diagonally on the free basis x^epsilon b^alpha, b_j=x_j^2+x_j. E_t=sum_(|T|=t) product_(j in T)D_j has eigenvalue binom(|supp alpha|,t) mod2. If f is in the ideal J_s generated by products of s distinct b_j and binom(s,t) is odd, M=f+E_t f lies in J_(s+1). E_t f has an explicit linear-placeholder Boolean correction of size O(binom(v,t)[3^t(S+v+t+1)]^4), depth at most 4delta+20 from size-S depth-delta f. For P=product_i(1+F_i) in J_s with binom(s,t) odd, every supplied refutation C linear in the full placeholder tuple can be patched to A+MC, with A determined only by the inputs and these corrections; all coordinate restrictions with at most s free variables agree with A. Polynomial overhead for fixed t; no exact Frege-image realization or unconditional small refutation.
claims.assessment: Working free-module projection and priority-patching proof, passed by the sole medium reviewer after repeating the patch's ideal/parity hypotheses and placeholder linearity. Growing t retains its explicit subset cost; repeated first-bit projection is idempotent.
claims.rationale: Tests all minimal coordinate faces simultaneously without enumerating faces, and identifies an affordable full-coset normalization obstructing compulsory face hardness.
claims.next_action: Determine what full-certificate information survives these costed support masks, with any simulation-image restriction explicit.

claims.summary: For binary rank inputs delta_ik+(AB)_ik with m>n>=1 and even r=m-n>0, every supplied Hilbert-like refutation admits a polynomial-size-overhead, constant-depth-overhead patch whose restrictions to all coordinate faces with at most r+1 free individual matrix entries equal the restrictions of one fixed cheap circuit independent of the refutation. Use P in J_(r+1), odd s=r+1 and E_1. In particular m=2n with even n is covered. No exact simulation-image preservation, unconditional small refutation or Frege lower bound is asserted.
claims.assessment: Working composition of sharp rank support with the first-bit support mask, passed by the sole medium reviewer. The transformation retains a supplied certificate and makes no unconditional small-refutation claim.
claims.rationale: A simultaneous obstruction to compulsory minimal-face hardness for the actual rank candidate, while leaving full-certificate complexity open.
claims.next_action: Test a full-certificate or exact-image invariant beyond the erased coordinate-face data.
